recent.text: After a 4-0‼️ week for the NFC East, here are the current division standings: 1. New York Giants -- 6-3-1 2. Dallas Cowboys -- 5-6 3. Washington Commanders -- 4-5-1 4. Philadelphia Eagles -- 3-7 https://t.co/9mGp8CXb2W

recent.text: That was a huge win for the Washington Commanders, who are now 4-5-1. That puts them 2 games back of the New York Giants in the NFC East and they own the tie-breaker. They also don't play a team with a winning record again until Dec. 27. https://t.co/AQ0ygOiyDj
recent.author: Ralph Vacchiano

recent.text: As I was saying …. Best QB in the division
recent.author: Ryan Dunleavy
recent.quoted_text: Are #Commanders (who tied #Giants and have best QB in division) the biggest threat in NFC East? Have we been sleeping on that by focusing on the fatally flawed #Eagles and defensively challenged #Cowboys?

recent.text: NFC East just got A LOT more interesting. #Giants have 2 game lead on #Commanders but WAS holds the tiebreaker (no other team can have a tiebreaker vs. Giants because of tie)
